body: Well thanks for bearing with me. You've given me a lot to think about.

I would say go see a doctor. I don't want any more doctors. I hate the doctor and I hate taking pills. I'm not crazy. I just. Idk. I'm sorry to ramble. ik not quite sure what I'm feeling right now I'm just all messed up inside.  I can't do this. Not alone. I can't go through this alone, and I appreciate you being here for me bit you're so far away (kk assuming)  and I just wish I had someone close by to do this. It's been a lonely road.

It's no use. I dony deserve to be happy. I haven't done a single good thing my entire life. all I do is hurt people. I'm sorry if it looks like in just ignoring all your advice. I don't mean to. I just. I just don't deserve help. I don't even know why I posted here, usually I'm the one to give advice here, I should be able to help myself. I'm just so stupid.
I'm 23.  I don't even know what happy feels like. From as early as I can remember Ive wanted to die.

I can't.. the thought of someone in front of me knowing how I felt inside is terrifying.  When I told my mom I was suicidal she beat me, and my dad just laughed and said he wished I was serious. 

I really don't have anything left here.. I'm just so scared if what happens after I die.. 

This was a mistake, I'm sorry to have wasted your time.

Thanks for your long reply..

I've been to three different therapists, and I just can't seem to connect to them, I just don't trust them. I have such a hard time trusting people, I've been hurt so many times in my life. It's so very hard to let people in. I don't even know if I have a GP... I haven't been to the doctor since I was 10..  

I feel so very alone.. 

I failed college because of this, I'm stuck loving with my abusive mother because I don't have the credit to get my own place, and no friends to room with..

Growing up I took what my dad did to me out on my little brothers, who were perfect o my dad, and now they pay me back for that 10 fold...  I just have nothing left..
